fix: address review feedback on timeouts, clean swaps, trimming and remix

- call_api's runner signals the child's whole process group and bounds the final
  output read, so a descendant holding the pipes can't outlast the timeout.
- Each curl attempt is capped to what is left of the retry deadline.
- A clean-version swap can't reintroduce a disliked, library, recent, seed or
  already-listed song; an explicit song and its clean twin become one entry.
- --minutes keeps a blend balanced, can drop a single end track to land the
  target, and remix reports kept/swapped counts for the trimmed playlist.
- remix reads every page of a long playlist (new catalog-playlist-tracks) and
  treats originals your filters rule out as swaps.
- Update the README coverage badge to 95%.

could leave config, feedback or snapshots half-written. Write an owner-only

commits.message:
Work through the issue backlog: security fix, --minutes, remix, clean mode, strategy split (#118)

* chore(renovate): bump pre-commit revs and group ruff and ShellCheck pins

Renovate's pre-commit manager is opt-in, so ruff bumps touched only
pyproject.toml and failed the pin guard in tests/test_ci_workflow.py
(PR #98). Enable it and group each tool's two pins into one PR.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(api): time out stalled requests and clean token files on SIGTERM

curl had no timeout, and call_api killed the script with SIGKILL, which bash
can't trap, leaving both tokens in $TMPDIR. Add curl connect/max timeouts and a
retry deadline, and end a stuck script with SIGTERM before SIGKILL.

Closes #60

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: raise the coverage floor from 80% to 90%

Coverage is at 95%, so an 80% floor let a large drop through unnoticed.

Closes #114

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test: exercise every API command and the other shell scripts

Run each apple_music_api.sh command against the mock, with a check that the
table matches the dispatcher so a new command can't ship untested. Cover
build_playlist.sh, new_releases.sh and the verify_setup.sh failure paths.

Also fix build_playlist.sh on an empty song-ID file: `grep -c || echo 0`
produced "0\n0", so it died on an arithmetic error instead of reporting
"No song IDs". The mock gains a catalog genres route.

Closes #113

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* ci: type-check scripts/ with a pinned mypy

Add mypy==2.4.0 to the [dev] extra, run it non-strict on scripts/ from
`make typecheck` (part of `make ci`), the lint job and the release gate, and
fix what it found. The bulk came from call_api's wide return type, which now
has overloads (raw=True gives str | None, otherwise Any).

Closes #115

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor: run sibling scripts through one run_script helper

strategy_engine.py and playlist_health.py each shelled out to build_playlist.sh
and apple_music_api.sh their own way. Add _common.run_script (bare script name,
SIGTERM-first timeout, captured text) and use it everywhere, including call_api.

playlist_health now reports a failed build_playlist.sh call with its stderr
instead of claiming the duplicate removal or replacement succeeded.

Closes #112

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor: split strategy_engine.py into one module per strategy

Move the eight strategies into scripts/strategies/, with the scoring constants,
sequencing and candidate helpers they share in their own modules.
strategy_engine.py keeps the CLI, naming and playlist-write calls and
re-exports the moved names, so every documented command and import still works.

daily_pick.py now shares TASTE_WEIGHT instead of redeclaring it (JITTER differs
on purpose and stays separate). Tests patch dependencies through
tests/strategy_helpers.patch_everywhere since each module imports them by name,
and the trust-claims scan now covers scripts/strategies/.

Closes #111

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat: --minutes for exact-length playlists on every strategy

--minutes N replaces --size: the strategy is asked for a pool about 30% larger
than N minutes needs, then tracks are dropped until the total durationInMillis
is within about a minute of N. Dropping from an ordered list keeps its order,
so energy arcs and constellation's gradient survive. The JSON reports
target_minutes and the real duration_minutes.

Every candidate now carries duration_ms, and the demo catalog has durations.

Closes #105

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat: remix any Apple Music playlist to your taste

Add --strategy remix --playlist-url <link or pl.ID>: fetch a catalog playlist
(new apple_music_api.sh catalog-playlist), keep the tracks that fit your taste
and swap the rest for the same artist's better fit, a similar artist, or more
from an artist you're keeping. The JSON reports how much was kept and each
swap's reason. Links are validated before any request.

Closes #101

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat: clean mode keeps explicit songs out of every playlist

clean_only in config.json (or --clean on strategy_engine.py) drops songs whose
contentRating is explicit from every strategy and the daily pick. A song with a
clean version (same title and artist) is swapped for it via a catalog search,
cached per song and capped at 15 per run. Candidates now carry an explicit flag.

Closes #109

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(demo): a 250-song catalog so demo playlists are full length

Demo mode and `demo.py serve` now run against DEMO_CATALOG: about 250 songs by
26 artists across ten genres, with a fictional listener whose history spans a
dozen of them. The old 13-song catalog stays as SMALL_CATALOG for the
integration tests. Artists' top songs span albums, and similar-artist lists
reach into other genres. A demo profile built from the old catalog is rebuilt
automatically, and the README replay is regenerated.

Closes #46

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: report a non-object --data file and an unreadable track-IDs file

taste_card.py --data now refuses valid JSON that isn't an object (a list or
null from a script that failed part-way) instead of crashing with an
AttributeError, in all three modes. playlist_history.py log reports a missing
or unreadable --track-ids-file with an ERROR line instead of a traceback and
logs nothing.

Closes #62
